newsitem.title: USA: AM Best to review Cigna, Healthsource.
newsitem.headline: AM Best to review Cigna, Healthsource.

text.p: Insurance rating firm A.M. Best said on Friday that it has placed under review the ratings of CIGNA Corp's life insurance units and the life and health maintenance organization (HMO) units of Healthsource Inc.
A.M. Best said CIGNA's plans to acquire Healthsource through a tender offer prompted A.M. Best to put the companies under review with developing implications.
CIGNA's property and casualty companies are not affected by this action.
A.M. Best said CIGNA's life insurance units have an "A+" (Superior) rating.

Healthsource's ratings are "A" (Excellent) for Healthsource Insurance Co and "A-" (Excellent) for its Healthsource Indiana Insurance Co, Healthsource Insurance Group and Healthsource Insurance Services units, A.M. Best said.

At Healthsource's HMO subsidiaries, the company has "A" ratings for Healthsource New Hampshire and "A-" ratings for Healthsource HMO of New York, Healthsource Indiana Managed Care Plan, Healthsource Maine, Healthsource North Carolina, Healthsource South Carolina and Healthsource Tennessee units, A.M. Best said.
